definition: I. [ קָלָה ] verb roast, parch (Late Hebrew קָלָה id. (rare), קָלִי = Biblical Hebrew; As kalû II. I, III. I burn, consume Meissn Suppl. 84 ; Sabean קלאתם conflagratio, aestus Os 4 ; Os 1 ; Os 19 ; Os 20 CIS iv. No 74, 1.20 ; Arabic fry or roast wheat; Ethiopic burn, fry , so ᵑ7 קְלָא Syriac ); — Qal Perfect 3 masculine singular suffix קָלָם בָּאֵשׁ Jer 29:22 (accusative of person) he roasted them with fire; Passive participle אָבִיב קָלוּי בָּאֵשׁ Lev 2:14 ( P ) grain parched with fire; so קָלוּי alone, as common food, Josh 5:11 ( P ), see קָלִי Niph`al Participle נִקְלֶה as noun Ps 38:8 my loins are filled with burning ( Vrss Bae with contempt , II. קלה ).
